main_products: Men's and ladies' suits, coats, workwear/professional wear, casual wear
woven_evidence: It is a long-established Western-style suit maker that exports suits and professional wear, mainly to Japan.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Hubei trade delegation's 137th fair offline booth allocation lists 美尔雅服饰有限公司 under Men's & Women's Wear (男女装) with 4 booths.

notes: It is linked to listed company Hubei Mailyard Co., Ltd. (600107). Its 2024 annual report shows export processing revenue down about 22%. Directories say around 2,000 workers and an industrial park in Tuanchengshan, Huangshi, and one directory also lists sweaters as a small line.
